name: WA-02
label: Safe D

key_factors: Incumbent Rick Larsen running with large fundraising edge ($2.0M raised vs. no reported total for Feller)
Prediction markets price Larsen at ~96% to win
model.rationale: The fundamentals point strongly to Larsen: a D+12 district, incumbency, and a dominant fundraising advantage over a little-known challenger. Markets price this as effectively decided, so the forecast stays near the baseline with only a modest haircut for the absence of polling.
model.watch: Any late surge in outside spending against Larsen or unexpected polling showing a single-digit race would warrant a downgrade.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Rick Larsen, a long-serving Democratic incumbent, seeks another term in a northwestern Washington district that leans Democratic by about twelve points. He enters the general election with roughly two million dollars raised and a large cash advantage, while Republican Edwin Feller has reported little financial activity and no outside groups are spending meaningfully in the race.

Prediction markets give Larsen roughly a 96 percent chance of winning, and no expert raters flag the seat as competitive. With no public general-election polling, the forecast rests on district fundamentals, which point to a comfortable double-digit Larsen win.
